test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Kanti and Jiya together can finish a work in 3 days. If Jiya alone can finish the work in 6 days, then in how many days can Kanti alone finish the work?
solution:
Given:

Kanti and Jiya complete a work in = 3 days

Jiya complete the work in = 6 days

Calculation:

One day's work of (Kanti + Jiya) = 1/3

One day's work of Jiya = 1/6

According to the question:

Kanti's one day's work = 1/3 – 1/6 = (2-1)/6 = 1/6

∴ Kanti can complete the work in 6 days.
